Everything else in the app is pulled automatically from the Texas
Comptroller, the Census, and FRED. Edit this file, commit it, and the
site picks it up on the next deploy - no Python or JavaScript to touch.

_note: Freddie Mac publishes only a 30-year headline rate, which the build
fetches automatically. These are the conventional spreads applied to
it for other products, in percentage points. Users can override the
rate outright in the sidebar, so these only set the default.
No free per-ZIP homeowners insurance API exists; the good data is
proprietary. This models a premium from the published state average,
scaled by dwelling coverage and a county risk factor. Refresh
state_avg_annual yearly - Texas premiums have been climbing fast.
Users can override with a real quote.
insurance.note: Modelled estimate, not a quote. Override with a real quote.

_note: Statutory exemption rules, keyed by state so other states can be
added as sibling entries without touching engine code. These change
only when the legislature acts - check after each session.
Texas legislature meets in odd-numbered years.

TX.note: Prop 13 (2025) raised the school homestead exemption to $140,000 effective 2026-01-01. Bexar County and the City of San Antonio each grant the maximum 20% local option.
